_note: Generated by scripts/build-photo-manifest.js. Do not hand-edit the mapping; fix the filename or the script's token list and regenerate. Alt text IS hand-edited, and as of 2026-08-05 a regenerate PRESERVES it rather than overwriting it: the script only writes the [DRAFT, NEEDS REVIEW] placeholder for entries that do not already have real alt. The same applies to locationStatus, duplicateGroup, duplicateNote, proposedUseNote and proposedUseLocked, and to proposedUse itself where proposedUseLocked is true. Run `npm run test:photos` to prove a regenerate is non-destructive. Placeholder fields (placeholder, placeholderSource, placeholderNote) are hand-authored and preserved the same way; see _placeholderRule.
_rule: The filename is the source of truth for what a photo shows. The directory a file arrived in is never read. A photo reaches a location page only if its filename names that location.
_placeholderRule: EVERY PHOTOGRAPH ON THIS SITE IS TAJIMA'S OWN. A stand-in is allowed only for a subject no Tajima photograph could ever cover (raw ingredients, dough texture, unbranded noodles, steam, wood or ceramic), never for a room, a storefront, or a plated bowl, and it is never presented as Tajima. Registering one is three hand-authored fields on its entry: placeholder: true, placeholderSource (the URL it came from), and placeholderNote (which real photograph replaces it and who is shooting it). All three are required and a partial registration fails too. src/_data/roomPhotos.js sweeps this whole manifest at module load and THROWS, which fails npm run build, so a placeholder cannot ship by being forgotten. TAJIMA_ALLOW_PLACEHOLDERS=1 npm run build is a client-preview escape hatch only: Cloudflare does not set it, so a placeholder still fails the deploy.
